# Omeagle

> Omeagle is the #1 free, anonymous random video chat and text chat platform connecting users worldwide with zero registration required.

Omeagle offers instant one-click peer-to-peer WebRTC video chat, anonymous text chat with no signup, gender/country/interest-based matching, built-in AI moderation and reporting, and a fully responsive PWA for desktop, iOS, and Android.

- [Anonymous Video Chat No Sign Up](https://omeagle.online/anonymous-video-chat-no-signup): 100% private and secure WebRTC video chat.

- [OmeTV Alternative Free](https://omeagle.online/ometv-alternative): Free OmeTV alternative without coin paywalls or strict auto-bans.
- [Gender Filter Video Chat](https://omeagle.online/gender-filter-video-chat): Random video chat with free male/female gender preference filter.
